ple_zulmashar_the_last.accept_text:
The Mossflayers follow a warlord who named himself after their city. Zul'Mashar the Last says he's the last of the old Amani blood, and he's sworn to drive everyone who isn't a troll out of these lands.

The raids won't stop while he's giving the orders.

He holds the top of the temple at Zul'Mashar, north of here. He's big, and he hits like a falling tree. Take friends, and bring bandages, because you'll need them.
